biography.html: Miki Naftali is an Israeli property developer based in New York and founder of Naftali Group. Born in Tel Aviv, he studied industrial engineering management at the University of Southern California. He became a partner in Elad Properties, overseeing the Plaza Hotel's redevelopment, before establishing his own luxury residential development business.

long_biography.plain_text:
At The Shephard in Manhattan's West Village, developer Miki Naftali redeveloped a former warehouse while retaining its distinctive exterior. The project combined restored brickwork and arched windows with new interiors, a garden and a carriage-house-inspired lobby. This work on an older building sat alongside his firm's developments built from the ground up.

Within his own company, Naftali required his daughter Danielle to learn the business from entry-level work. She began at reception and moved through administrative and sales-office roles before leading marketing and design. Her responsibilities expanded as she gained experience, allowing him more time to pursue new developments.

confidence.reason: Official project description and his direct explanation of Danielle's progression support the concrete property and management account. The daughter's own account independently confirms the entry-level requirement.
